speeches.speaker: Sarah Hanson-Young
speeches.brief: The Marriage Equality Amendment Bill 2013 was introduced to redefine marriage as between two people regardless of sex, sexual orientation or gender identity, removing the restriction to a man and a woman. The bill was supported by 62% of Australians according to a national survey, and previous votes were blocked by both the Opposition Leader refusing a conscience vote and the Prime Minister not enforcing party policy.
